chapter: Army service and after the war
title: Wartime travel and booking commissions
summary: They travelled by bus and crowded troop trains; booking fees were 15 percent for one-nighters and ten for locations.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, how were you travelling then? And, of course, this was wartime, wasn't it?
This was wartime.
How were you travelling during these one-nighters?
Sometimes we'd get a bus and sometimes we'd take the train.
So that was hard.
Uh-huh, it was.
It was hard travelling by train and by bus, wasn't it?

Well, a lot of times, if the tour was set up pretty nice, it wasn't too bad by train, because you can move around on a train, you can sleep on the train. But when they had those jumps in there, pretty good jumps, it was pretty hard by train, you see.
And it was -- even when we had the bus it was kind of hard, because you couldn't sleep as comfortable on a bus as you could on a train.
But some guys told me that during that time they were talking about, sometimes they couldnt' get a seat and that sort of thing.
Well, now, that was -- you did run into things like that because the train was moving soldiers and it was -- you'd run into those things like that. Yes.
So 90 days of that could be pretty hard.
Yes, it had its good points and its bad points.
You weren't at a point where you could get any locations.

Well, we didn't do very many locations, because -- well, quite naturally, the guys are still in the booking, see, they getting this money nightly, nightly, nightly, and so they don't fool with any locations because they're not
Yeah.
Well, they got 15 percent for the one-nighters.
How's that?
Wasn't that the rule then? They took 15 percent for one-nighters, ten percent for location thing.

Well, yes, and sometimes it was a certain amount. Sometimes it was ten percent, and that was a certain amount, and 15 percent. And locations was ten percent. So where, like you say, they didn't make the money in the locations.
Well, when you sit down in a location, you might get less money but your expenses are a lot less also.
That's true, yes.
